deals.headline: Rastar takes control of Espanyol with 56% for EUR 17.76m
deals.seller: Daniel Sánchez Llibre, Ramón Condal and other shareholders
deals.summary: Chinese toy and entertainment group Rastar closed the purchase of 56% of the club at EUR 78 a share, paying EUR 17.76m and taking over the guarantees the previous core shareholders had given the lending banks; the price valued 100% of the club at EUR 31.718m. Chen Yansheng was to take over as president.

deals.headline: Espanyol joins LaLiga Impulso with a EUR 77.8m allocation
deals.summary: Espanyol adhered to LaLiga's participating-financing contract funded by CVC and was allocated EUR 77.80m, drawn in instalments to June 2024, at 0% fixed interest plus 1.52% of its distributable audiovisual income, amortised over 50 years.

deals.evidence: 40 millones de euros y vencimiento el 30 de junio de 2027
deals.headline: Rastar turns its Espanyol loan line into a EUR 40m participating loan
deals.summary: An EUR 18m loan line from the majority shareholder signed on 15 April 2023 was converted during 2023-24 into a EUR 40m participating loan maturing 30 June 2027, secured on player-sale receivables; a further EUR 12m commercial loan from the shareholder was signed on 25 June 2024 (EUR 1.5m drawn at 30 June 2024).

deals.date_text: Approved end of June 2025; registered August 2025
deals.evidence: RCD Espanyol hace efectiva la ampliación de capital de 32 millones de euros
deals.headline: Espanyol completes a EUR 32m capital increase
deals.summary: Shareholders approved the increase with 99.98% of votes at the late-June 2025 extraordinary meeting; it was cut from the EUR 37.99m first proposed after the sale of goalkeeper Joan García, and left subscribed capital at EUR 197.58m.

deals.evidence: la operación valora al Espanyol en 130 millones y el pago se dividirá en 65 millones en efectivo y 65 millones en acciones de Velocity Sport Limited
deals.headline: Alan Pace's Velocity buys Espanyol from Rastar at a EUR 130m valuation
deals.investor: Velocity Sports Partners / Velocity Sport Limited (ALK Capital, Alan Pace)
deals.summary: Rastar sold its entire holding for EUR 130m: EUR 65m in cash and EUR 65m in Velocity Sport Limited shares, giving Rastar 16.45% of the VSL parent. The sale was approved by Spain's Consejo Superior de Deportes and completed on 9 October 2025, when the club announced VSP had acquired a majority stake.

deals.evidence: La inversión alcanza los 200 millones de dólares, según avanza Bloomberg.
deals.headline: Cynosure Checketts Sports Capital invests USD 200m in ALK Capital, owner of Espanyol and Burnley
deals.summary: David Checketts' newly formed private equity fund, raising USD 1.2bn, made its first sports investment by buying a stake in ALK Capital, the holding through which Alan Pace controls Velocity Sport Limited (Espanyol) and Burnley FC; Bloomberg put the investment at USD 200m. The stake is in the holding, not directly in the club.

name: Reial Club Deportiu Espanyol de Barcelona, S.A.D.
notes: The 2024-25 accounts on the club's transparency page are a scanned PDF, so revenue and its split come from Palco23's report of them (net profit EUR 2.2m, helped by Joan García's EUR 26.4m sale to Barcelona); the same article's comparison figure for 2023-24 (EUR 13.7m) conflicts with Palco23's earlier EUR 23.73m turnover for that Segunda División season. Wages, operating and pre-tax results are not on a readable page. VSP's exact percentage of the club is not stated anywhere found: Rastar's two Hong Kong vehicles held 84.34% and 15.26% at 30 June 2024 and sold their entire holding. Capacity is the stadium operator's 37,776 (the original design was for 40,000). La Vanguardia (Oct 2025) names J.J. Watt among VSL's shareholders. In January 2026 Pace publicly denied a report of a missed instalment to Rastar. Espanyol played LaLiga in 2025-26 and 2026-27. No social-media counts found on a citable page.

ownership_summary: RCD Espanyol is majority-owned by Velocity Sports Partners (Velocity Sport Limited), the sports investment arm of Alan Pace's ALK Capital, which also controls Burnley FC. Rastar Group (Chen Yansheng), owner since January 2016 and holder of 84.34% (Rastar Sports (HK)) plus 15.26% (Rastar Games (HK)) at 30 June 2024, agreed the sale on 14 July 2025 at a EUR 130m valuation, paid EUR 65m in cash and EUR 65m in VSL shares; the deal completed on 9 October 2025 and left Rastar with 16.45% of the VSL parent. In November 2025 Cynosure Checketts Sports Capital, David Checketts' new private equity fund, bought a stake in ALK Capital for USD 200m. Alan Pace is president; Mao Ye Wu is CEO.
